intro: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.
description:
Pick your target and prepare to bring an entire world to a spectacular end.

Take command of devastating cosmic power and turn planets into your personal destruction experiments. Select a world, choose your weapon, and watch the catastrophe unfold. Tear through the surface, split the planet into fragments, trigger a colossal supernova, or unleash a black hole that consumes everything in its path.

Experiment with different tools and discover how each one changes the fate of your target. Clear, intuitive controls let newcomers begin destroying immediately while giving experienced players the freedom to stage their own cosmic catastrophes.

KEY FEATURES

• Choose from different planets
• Wield a variety of destructive cosmic weapons
• Tear planetary surfaces apart
• Trigger spectacular supernovas
• Unleash all-consuming black holes
• Experiment with space and physics using intuitive controls

How much destruction can one planet withstand? There is only one way to find out.
